in_sanskrit.name: गुरु

in_tamil.name: குரு

in_telugu.name: గురు
in_telugu.long_meaning: One who removes darkness, One who is learned and wise.

in_marathi.name: Guru
in_marathi.long_meaning: Guru हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who removes the darkness of ignorance and guides on the path of enlightenment.
